limitations: L4 means offline synthetic fixture arithmetic acceptance only; no actual assay, biological, physical or clinical validation.
Read counts and called intervals are supplied; FRiP uses original called peaks and cannot subtract blacklist reads without read-level data.
All available pairs are gated before exclusions; a poor partner may conservatively exclude otherwise similar libraries.
Historical freeze order and true experimental independence cannot be proven by hashes or labels; review stays coordinator-owned.

Conservative English whole-word prefix families (case insensitive): caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. The gate additionally refuses enhanc*, promot*, truth, physical validity and patient benefit, includes negations and is incomplete for unlisted paraphrases.
Any unavailable cited source requires unavailable claims. Computed agreement and review approval cannot support positive claims; replicated status is refused.
Inputs are descriptor-pinned with complete ancestor identity checks, 64 MiB per file, 256 MiB aggregate distinct bytes and 4000000 JSON values.
